PZZ700-090915-
124 PM PDT Thu Oct 8 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1025 mb high was about 400 nautical miles west of Cape
Blanco, Oregon, and a 1004 mb low was over southern Arizona. A 
988 mb low was at the core of Tropical Storm Rachel 850 nautical 
miles west of Cabo San Lucas. Weak onshore northwest flow will 
prevail through Saturday. The remnants of Rachel will bring a 
rapid increase in southerly swell along with gusty winds and 
choppy seas Sunday, diminishing somewhat on Monday. More typical
onshore flow returns by Tuesday.
